ccn: CMS Certification Numbers — ccn-package
text: vctrs class representing CMS Certification Number, uniform way identifying Providers Suppliers participated Medicare Medicaid programs. CCN alphanumeric string, either 6 10 characters length, encodes Provider/Supplier's State Facility type, defined CMS Manual System Pub. 100-07 Medicare State Operations: Provider Certification.
